body.en: On 26 September 1935 the military installed the engineer Federico Páez as jefe supremo; he stayed in office until his own defence minister, General Alberto Enríquez Gallo, staged a coup in October 1937, and Enríquez Gallo assumed the supreme leadership on 23 October 1937.

body.zh-Hant: 1881年9月5日生於布拉格斯米霍夫；在布拉格的捷克大學念法律，1906年進入警界。1918年1月1日調至國家警察總局，1918年10月30日出任布拉格警察局長，1920年5月20日升任布拉格警察總監。
body.en: Born on 5 September 1881 in Smíchov (Prague), he studied law at the Czech university in Prague and joined the police in 1906. He was moved to the state police presidium on 1 January 1918, became Prague police director on 30 October 1918 and Prague police president on 20 May 1920.

heading.zh-Hant: 地方行政與保護國政府
heading.en: Provincial administration and the Protectorate government

body.zh-Hant: 1924至1939年任波希米亞地方政務副首長（zemský viceprezident）；1939年11月至1942年1月任波希米亞地方總監（zemský prezident）；1942年1月至1945年5月任保護國內政部長；1945年1月19日至5月5日領導最後一屆保護國政府，並代理重病的國家總統哈查。
body.en: He was vice-president of the provincial political administration in 1924–39, provincial president in Bohemia from November 1939 to January 1942, and interior minister in the Protectorate government from January 1942 to May 1945; from 19 January to 5 May 1945 he headed the last Protectorate government and also acted for the gravely ill State President Hácha.

citations.quote: 1924–39 zastával funkci viceprezidenta zemské správy politické
Od listopadu 1939 do ledna 1942 byl zemským prezidentem v Čechách
od ledna 1942 do května 1945 ministrem vnitra v protektorátní vládě
od 19. 1. do 5. 5. 1945 stál v čele poslední protektorátní vlády
a současně zastupoval těžce nemocného státního prezidenta E. Háchu

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月5日他試圖在廣播中發表關於保護國終結的演說未果，不久被捷克民族委員會拘押。1946年4月29日至7月31日在布拉格國民法庭審理保護國政府案，他因有減刑情節被判三年徒刑，1947年5月12日獲附條件釋放。
body.en: On 5 May 1945 he tried without success to broadcast a speech on the end of the Protectorate and was soon detained by the Czech National Council. In the trial of the Protectorate government before the National Court in Prague (29 April – 31 July 1946) he was sentenced to three years in prison given mitigating circumstances, and was conditionally released on 12 May 1947.

heading.zh-Hant: 廣州市長與國民政府時期
heading.en: Guangzhou mayor and the Nationalist Government

body.zh-Hant: 1921年被任命為廣州市長；1925年廣州國民政府成立後為國府委員，兼廣東省政府委員與建設廳長；1926年當選國民黨第二屆中央執行委員；1928年起任國民政府委員，並先後任財政部長、鐵道部長、考試院副院長。
body.en: He was appointed mayor of Guangzhou in 1921; when the Guangzhou Nationalist Government was founded in 1925 he became a government member and Guangdong provincial government member and head of its construction department; in 1926 he was elected to the KMT's second Central Executive Committee; from 1928 he served as a member of the National Government and successively as finance minister, railways minister and vice-president of the Examination Yuan.

body.zh-Hant: 1931年2月，蔣介石因約法問題拘禁胡漢民，孫科辭職；同年12月他出任行政院長，不到百日辭職。1933年1月6日就任立法院院長。1938年3月至1939年7月，他以特使身分三次赴莫斯科交涉抗日貸款。
body.en: In February 1931 Chiang Kai-shek detained Hu Hanmin over the provisional-constitution dispute; in December he became president of the Executive Yuan and resigned in under a hundred days. He took office as president of the Legislative Yuan on 6 January 1933, and as special envoy made three trips to Moscow between March 1938 and July 1939 to negotiate loans for the war against Japan.

body.en: On 18 April 1947 he was appointed vice-chairman of the National Government and president of the Legislative Yuan; he became president of the Executive Yuan on 23 December 1948, returned to Taiwan in 1966 as president of the Examination Yuan, and died in 1973.

body.zh-Hant: 依 Ruiz Navas 的會議論文，1906年10月9日憲法制定會議開議，阿爾法羅曾向會議致送訊息；1908年有《慈善法》與《永業法（Ley de Manos Muertas）》；1911年2月12日利耶拉主教將一份請求轉呈基多，旨在請阿爾法羅歸還土地。本段只寫該文提及的事，不含其任期與生平。
body.en: According to Ruiz Navas's conference paper, the Constituent Assembly opened on 9 October 1906 and Eloy Alfaro (spelled "Alfara" in the text) sent it a message; the Ley de Beneficencia and Ley de Manos Muertas date from 1908; and on 12 February 1911 Bishop Riera forwarded to Quito a request aimed at obtaining from Alfaro the return of land. This paragraph covers only what that paper mentions, not his term of office or biography.

citations.quote: Mensaje de Eloy Alfara a la Asamblea Constituyente
Asamblea Constituyente que se instaló el 9 de octubre de 1906
la Ley de Beneficencia de 1908 y la Ley de Manos Muertas de 1908
El 12 de febrero de 1911 el Obispo Riera remitió a Quito una solicitud
destinado a obtener de Alfaro la devolución del terreno

gaps.note: 1906–1911 年（與 1908–1945 窗口交集 1908–1911）的元首任期：A／B 來源（UASB Ayala Mora 摘要、FLACSO、Britannica、Chauvin 論文）皆被驗證頁／Cloudflare 擋下，不繞過；Encyclopedia.com（無署名，未評等）寫 interim 1906–1907, constitutional 1907–1911，僅供候選。該任期應已在名單 5442 內。
生卒年、出身、1908–1911 任內經歷皆待具名作者或國家級來源（本批只取得 Ruiz Navas 論文片段）。

people.name: Christian Rakovsky
people.nameZh: 克里斯蒂安·拉科夫斯基

heading.zh-Hant: 早年求學與社會主義活動

body.zh-Hant: 1890至1893年在日內瓦習醫，1894年在蘇黎世，1897年在蒙彼利埃取得博士學位；1918年加入布爾什維克黨。
body.en: He studied medicine in Geneva in 1890–93, in Zürich in 1894 and took a doctorate at Montpellier in 1897; in 1918 he joined the Bolshevik party.

citations.quote: 1890-93 Medizinstud. in Genf, 1894 in Zürich, 1897 Doktorat in Montpellier.
In 1918 he joined the Bolshevik party

heading.zh-Hant: 烏克蘭蘇維埃政府首腦與大使任命
heading.en: Head of the Soviet Ukrainian government and ambassadorships

body.zh-Hant: 1919年1月至1923年7月（其間有中斷）他領導蘇維埃烏克蘭政府；其後任（蘇聯）駐英國（1923–25）與法國（1925–27）大使。
body.en: From January 1919 until July 1923, with interruptions, he headed the Soviet Ukrainian government; he was then ambassador to Britain (1923–5) and France (1925–7).

citations.quote: From January 1919 until July 1923, with interruptions,
he headed the Soviet Ukrainian government
USSR ambassador to Britain (1923–5) and France (1925–7)

body.zh-Hant: 據 IEU，1927年12月他被開除出黨，一個月後被流放到阿斯特拉罕；1929年起為蘇聯國內公認的左翼反對派領袖；1934年2月服從黨紀，其後主持衛生人民委員部下的科研機構；1937年秋被捕，1938年3月被判二十年徒刑，後遭槍決（HLS 記為1941年）。
body.en: IEU records that he was expelled from the party in December 1927 and exiled to Astrakhan a month later; from 1929 he was the recognized leader of the Left Opposition within the USSR; in February 1934 he submitted to party discipline and directed research institutes of the Commissariat of Health; arrested in autumn 1937 and sentenced in March 1938 to twenty years, he was shot (HLS gives 1941).

citations.quote: In December 1927, at the 15th congress of the Russian Communist party
he was expelled from the party, and a month later he was exiled to Astrakhan
From 1929 he was the recognized leader of the Left Opposition within the USSR
In February 1934 he submitted to party discipline
he directed the scientific research institutes of the Commissariat of Health
In the fall of 1937 he was arrested as a spy
in March 1938 he was sentenced to 20 years’ imprisonment
He was shot in a Soviet prison.
1927 wurde er aus der KP ausgeschlossen, 1941 erschossen.
